description: Technical cost-driver semantics per engine — units and shapes only, never prices.

snowflake.notes: Credits require explicit export; warehouse uptime proxies compute spend. Queue time does not directly cost but extends uptime.

bigquery.notes: bytes_processed/bytes_billed map to scan_volume; slot-ms map to slot_usage. Reservations are config evidence, not runtime.

redshift.notes: Serverless bills RPU-seconds (proxied by duration); provisioned bills node-hours. Concurrency scaling appears as extra cluster time.

spark.notes: Executor time = sum of task durations; cluster uptime is separate evidence. Shuffle/spill drive network+disk I/O.

databricks.notes: DBU consumption follows executor/cluster time; no DBU claims without export.

emr.notes: Node-hours proxy cluster duration; shuffle/spill indicate wasted I/O.

trino.notes: No billing unit; drivers are cluster-time and I/O shapes.

clickhouse.notes: Self-managed: cost drivers are node time, storage, and replication fan-out.

opensearch.notes: Nodes/shards/replicas/storage dominate; shard count amplifies per-request work.
